title: BAM: Bivariate Additive Models for Interpretable Tabular Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.05940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generalized Additive Models with pairwise interactions (GA$^2$Ms) are regarded as glass-box models, since each pairwise shape function can be visualized as a contour plot. In practice, the shape functions learned by methods such as EBM or NODE-GAM are so complex (irregular contours and sharp local fluctuations) that a practitioner cannot meaningfully interpret them or check them against domain knowledge. Auditability in this stronger sense requires substantially simpler shape functions. We argue that such simplification can match the accuracy of standard GAMs if the right feature pairs are captured. We propose Bivariate Additive Models (BAMs), a class of GA$^2$Ms in which every pairwise shape function is constrained to a simple parametric form, instantiated as an asymmetric bivariate Gaussian. translated_title: BAM：用于可解释表格预测的二元可加模型
translated_abstract: 具有成对交互作用的广义可加模型（GA²M）被视为玻璃箱模型，因为每个成对形状函数都可以可视化为等高线图。但在实践中，EBM 或 NODE-GAM 等方法学习到的形状函数过于复杂（等高线不规则且局部波动剧烈），以至于从业者无法对其进行有意义的解释，也无法对照领域知识加以检验。这种更强意义上的可审计性需要显著更简单的形状函数。我们认为，只要捕捉到正确的特征对，这样的简化可以达到与标准 GAM 相当的精度。我们提出二元可加模型，这是一类 GA²M，其中每个成对形状函数都被约束为简单的参数形式，具体实例化为非对称二元高斯分布。每个组件都可以可视化为单峰等高线图，并且其特征对在训练过程中自动选择。在六个表格数据集上的实验……
tldr: 提出 Bivariate Additive Models（BAM），将 GA²M 中的每个成对形状函数约束为非对称二元高斯的简单参数形式，在保持与标准 GAM 相当精度的同时，使每个交互项都可可视化为单峰等高线图并自动选择特征对，从而实现真正可解释、可审计的表格预测。
en_tdlr: BAM (Bivariate Additive Models) constrains every pairwise shape function in GA²Ms to a simple parametric form—an asymmetric bivariate Gaussian—automatically selecting feature pairs during training, so that each interaction is visualizable as a unimodal contour map while matching standard GAM accuracy for truly interpretable and auditable tabular prediction.
